outcome.answer: The closest matches are [2], [5], [7], [9], and [10]. [2] studies authorship verification under genre, time, and AI-era shifts, using feature-based, embedding-based, and LLM-based approaches. [5] analyzes stylistic differences between human and LLM writing across genres, models, and decoding strategies. [7] shows that an LLM trained on one author’s works can capture that author’s style. [9] evaluates personalization methods and finds they modulate style but do not bridge the gap to human authorship. [10] studies federated personalized generation and author-style homogenization, proposing a method to retain authorial voice.
